entries.en: The bookstore displayed her bestselling novel near the entrance.
entries.zh: 书店在入口附近陈列了她的畅销小说。

entries.en: We had a ducky little picnic beside the lake.
entries.zh: 我们在湖边进行了一次很愉快的小野餐。

entries.en: The specimen had a porous, spongiform structure.
entries.zh: 这份标本具有多孔的海绵状结构。

entries.en: She added a splash of mirin to the sauce.
entries.zh: 她往酱汁里加了少许甜米酒。

entries.en: A nor'easter kept the fishing boats in the harbor.
entries.zh: 一场东北风暴使渔船滞留在港口。

entries.en: The hospital organized a seminar on bariatric care.
entries.zh: 医院组织了一场有关肥胖症治疗护理的研讨会。

entries.en: A skeeter buzzed around the lantern outside our tent.
entries.zh: 一只蚊子绕着帐篷外的灯嗡嗡飞。

entries.en: We sheltered from the rain inside the galleria.
entries.zh: 我们在有顶商业街廊里避雨。

entries.en: The dragster waited at the starting line.
entries.zh: 高速改装赛车在起跑线上等候。

entries.en: The confraternity raised funds to restore the old chapel.
entries.zh: 协会募集资金，修复那座旧礼拜堂。

entries.en: He promised hollowly that everything would be different.
entries.zh: 他空洞地承诺，一切都会不同。

entries.en: The shelves were made from inexpensive particleboard.
entries.zh: 这些架子用便宜的碎木板制成。

entries.en: The collegium recorded its decision in the meeting minutes.
entries.zh: 委员会把决定记入了会议纪要。

entries.en: The knifepoint left a tiny mark in the wax.
entries.zh: 刀尖在蜡上留下了一个小印记。

entries.en: The diagram shows the position of an endotracheal tube.
entries.zh: 示意图显示了气管内插管的位置。

entries.en: The historian compared Arian teachings with those of rival groups.
entries.zh: 历史学家比较了阿里乌斯派与其他派别的教义。

entries.en: The theater plans to restage the comedy next winter.
entries.zh: 剧院计划明年冬天重新上演这部喜剧。

entries.en: He layered provolone and sliced tomatoes inside the sandwich.
entries.zh: 他把波萝伏洛干酪和番茄片分层夹进三明治。

entries.en: Her shoes clicked across the polished terrazzo.
entries.zh: 她的鞋走过抛光水磨石地面，发出清脆响声。

entries.en: The essay challenges a solipsistic view of experience.
entries.zh: 文章质疑了一种唯我论的经验观。

entries.en: They tried to gatecrash the party without an invitation.
entries.zh: 他们没有请柬，却试图混进派对。

entries.en: The leaderless committee postponed its decision again.
entries.zh: 没有领导的委员会再次推迟了决定。

entries.en: As a flatlander, she found the steep mountain paths tiring.
entries.zh: 作为平地居民，她觉得陡峭山路走起来很累。

entries.en: The astronomer examined observations of a distant magnetar.
entries.zh: 天文学家研究了一颗遥远磁星的观测资料。

entries.en: The laptop's touchpad stopped responding during the presentation.
entries.zh: 演示期间，笔记本电脑的触摸板不再响应。

entries.en: He felt a moment of schadenfreude when his rival slipped.
entries.zh: 看到对手滑倒，他有一瞬间幸灾乐祸。

entries.en: The mathematical model allows the distance to become infinitesimally small.
entries.zh: 这个数学模型允许距离变得无限小。

entries.en: He spoke incomprehensibly through a mouthful of bread.
entries.zh: 他嘴里塞着面包，说的话让人听不懂。

entries.en: The sculptor presented a clay maquette to the committee.
entries.zh: 雕塑家向委员会展示了一件黏土初步设计模型。

entries.en: The maintenance log recorded the boiler's scheduled blowdown.
entries.zh: 维护日志记录了锅炉的计划排污。

entries.en: The regionalist filled her stories with local speech and customs.
entries.zh: 这位乡土作家在故事中大量描写当地语言和习俗。

entries.en: She can telecommute from home two days a week.
entries.zh: 她每周有两天可以在家远程工作。

entries.en: The pathologist examined the ductal tissue in the section.
entries.zh: 病理学家检查了切片中的导管组织。

entries.en: He translated the letter from Urdu into English.
entries.zh: 他把这封信从乌尔都语译成了英语。

entries.en: The final chapter reveals the villain's tragic backstory.
entries.zh: 最后一章揭示了反派的悲惨背景故事。

entries.en: The historian studied naturopathic practices in early health manuals.
entries.zh: 历史学家研究了早期保健手册中的自然医术实践。

entries.en: They served chilled Chablis with the evening meal.
entries.zh: 他们在晚餐时供应了冰镇的法国干白葡萄酒。

entries.en: The committee acknowledged the exceptionality of the circumstances.
entries.zh: 委员会承认这些情况具有例外性。

entries.en: The preacher accused the merchant of behaving sinfully.
entries.zh: 传教士指责商人的行为有违道德。

entries.en: Her principles remained uncompromised despite pressure from the board.
entries.zh: 尽管董事会施压，她的原则仍未妥协。

entries.en: Her virtuosic performance drew prolonged applause.
entries.zh: 她精湛的演奏赢得了长时间的掌声。

entries.en: The farmer moved the irrigator to the far field.
entries.zh: 农民把灌溉设备移到了远处的田地。

entries.en: The envoy accepted an intercessory role in the dispute.
entries.zh: 使者接受了调解这场争端的角色。

entries.en: The study examined insects that parasitize other insects.
entries.zh: 这项研究考察了寄生于其他昆虫的昆虫。

entries.en: He decided to reapply after improving his portfolio.
entries.zh: 改进作品集后，他决定重新申请。

entries.en: The experiment measured responses to submaximal effort.
entries.zh: 实验测量了低于最大用力程度时的反应。

entries.en: The report linked bureaucratization with delays in routine decisions.
entries.zh: 报告把官僚化与日常决策的延误联系起来。

entries.en: She misguidedly ignored the warning about the damaged bridge.
entries.zh: 她不明智地忽视了桥梁受损的警告。

entries.en: The musician repaired a cracked castanet before the performance.
entries.zh: 乐手在演出前修补了一块开裂的响板。

entries.en: Floating staircases filled the film's strange dreamscape.
entries.zh: 电影奇异的梦中幻景里满是漂浮的楼梯。

entries.en: The cafe played mellow electronica during the afternoon.
entries.zh: 咖啡馆在下午播放柔和的电子音乐。

entries.en: His fisted hand hovered above the desk.
entries.zh: 他握成拳头的手悬在桌子上方。

entries.en: A clump of citronella grew beside the garden path.
entries.zh: 花园小路旁长着一丛香茅。

entries.en: A hellacious gust tore the loose sign from the wall.
entries.zh: 一阵猛烈的风把松动的招牌从墙上扯了下来。

entries.en: The lecture examined aestheticism through poetry and interior design.
entries.zh: 讲座通过诗歌与室内设计考察了唯美主义。

entries.en: She lent me a newish bicycle for the weekend.
entries.zh: 她借给我一辆还很新的自行车过周末。

entries.en: He tried to intellectualize his grief by analyzing every detail.
entries.zh: 他试图通过分析每个细节，用理性处理悲伤。

entries.en: She poured hot water over the yerba in the cup.
entries.zh: 她把热水倒在杯里的巴拉圭茶上。

entries.en: Fresh bread smelled enticingly warm in the bakery.
entries.zh: 面包店里，新鲜面包散发着温热诱人的香气。

entries.en: They packed their skiwear before checking the mountain forecast.
entries.zh: 他们先收拾了滑雪服装，然后查看山区天气预报。

entries.en: The team documented the norming of its assessment procedure.
entries.zh: 团队记录了评估程序的规范化过程。

entries.en: The boxer was a thumper with a powerful right hand.
entries.zh: 这名拳击手是一位右拳有力的重拳手。

entries.en: Flextime allowed her to collect the children after school.
entries.zh: 弹性上班制让她能在放学后接孩子。

entries.en: A geochemist analyzed the minerals in the rock samples.
entries.zh: 一位地球化学家分析了岩石样本中的矿物。

entries.en: The chart places the galaxies within a larger supercluster.
entries.zh: 星图把这些星系标示在一个更大的超星系团内。

entries.en: The archive supplied evidence for her ethnohistorical study.
entries.zh: 档案馆为她的人种史学研究提供了证据。

entries.en: The analysis compared phenolic compounds in the extracts.
entries.zh: 分析比较了这些提取物中的酚类化合物。

entries.en: The committee faced a Gordian problem of overlapping responsibilities.
entries.zh: 委员会面临职责重叠这一棘手问题。

entries.en: He sliced kielbasa into the simmering soup.
entries.zh: 他把波兰熏肠切片放入微炖的汤中。

entries.en: The report distinguished the unindicted witnesses from the defendants.
entries.zh: 报告区分了未被起诉的证人与被告。

entries.en: The change increased the influence of landholding families.
entries.zh: 这一变化增强了拥有土地的家族的影响力。

entries.en: The experiment compared bioavailability across the two formulations.
entries.zh: 实验比较了两种配方的生物可利用率。

entries.en: A sexologist discussed the history of sexuality research.
entries.zh: 一位性学家讨论了性研究的历史。

entries.en: Their cabin stood out in the boonies beyond the highway.
entries.zh: 他们的小屋坐落在公路以外的偏远乡野。

entries.en: The colourist adjusted the tones in the final sequence.
entries.zh: 配色师调整了最后一组镜头的色调。

entries.en: The audit found that some branches underreport their expenses.
entries.zh: 审计发现一些分支机构少报费用。

entries.en: The accommodationist urged both factions to accept a compromise.
entries.zh: 妥协迁就者敦促两派接受折中方案。

entries.en: The corpsman checked the soldier's bandage before they moved.
entries.zh: 出发前，战地医护兵检查了士兵的绷带。

entries.en: The company prez stopped by our office after lunch.
entries.zh: 公司总裁午饭后来了一趟我们办公室。

entries.en: The brochure should not oversell what the hotel actually offers.
entries.zh: 宣传册不应过分吹嘘酒店实际提供的服务。

entries.en: The story follows a nanobot exploring a damaged machine.
entries.zh: 故事讲述一个超微型机器人探索损坏机器的经历。

entries.en: The label describes the fabric as hypoallergenic.
entries.zh: 标签称这种面料具有低致敏性。

entries.en: The survey distinguished circumcised and uncircumcised participants.
entries.zh: 调查区分了受过割礼与未受割礼的参与者。

entries.en: The app will preload the map before the journey begins.
entries.zh: 应用会在行程开始前预加载地图。

entries.en: He disliked being called a shorty by his classmates.
entries.zh: 他不喜欢被同学叫作矮个子。

entries.en: A tiny beastie crawled across the damp leaf.
entries.zh: 一只小动物爬过潮湿的叶片。

entries.en: The farmworker repaired a broken gate beside the field.
entries.zh: 农业工人修好了田边的一扇破门。

entries.en: The neuropsychologist explained the results of the memory assessment.
entries.zh: 神经心理学家解释了记忆评估的结果。

entries.en: The students used a sourcebook of early travel accounts.
entries.zh: 学生使用了一本早期旅行记述资料集。

entries.en: The essay examines statism through debates about economic planning.
entries.zh: 文章通过经济规划的争论考察国家主义。

entries.en: We had to recross the stream before reaching camp.
entries.zh: 抵达营地前，我们不得不再次渡过溪流。

entries.en: The lecturer used geometry to explain incommensurability.
entries.zh: 讲师用几何学解释不可通约性。

entries.en: The oysterman returned to shore with a loaded basket.
entries.zh: 采牡蛎者提着装满的篮子返回岸边。

entries.en: The cobbler replaced the damaged toepiece of the boot.
entries.zh: 鞋匠更换了靴子损坏的鞋头。

entries.en: The documentary traces the early use of Technicolour.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片追溯了彩色印片法的早期使用。

entries.en: Her sparky questions kept the discussion moving.
entries.zh: 她活泼的提问让讨论不断推进。

entries.en: The builder checked the infilling between the stone panels.
entries.zh: 建筑工人检查了石板之间的填补物。

entries.en: The tissue calcified gradually around the damaged area.
entries.zh: 受损部位周围的组织逐渐钙化。

entries.en: The organizers handled the sudden change commendably.
entries.zh: 组织者很好地应对了突如其来的变化。

entries.en: The poem celebrates our creaturely need for warmth and company.
entries.zh: 这首诗赞颂了我们作为生物对温暖与陪伴的需要。

entries.en: She practiced writing kanji in a squared notebook.
entries.zh: 她在方格本上练习写日语汉字。

entries.en: The cabinet was carved from dark cherrywood.
entries.zh: 这个柜子用深色樱桃木雕制而成。

entries.en: A sheet of Plexiglas protected the fragile drawing.
entries.zh: 一块树脂玻璃保护着那幅脆弱的画作。

entries.en: The film engaged viewers affectively through its intimate family scenes.
entries.zh: 电影通过亲密的家庭场景在情感上打动了观众。

entries.en: He resented being dismissed as a pipsqueak by senior colleagues.
entries.zh: 他不满资深同事把他当作无足轻重的小人物。

entries.en: She gave a careful, lawyerly answer to the ambiguous question.
entries.zh: 她以律师般审慎的方式回答了这个含糊的问题。

entries.en: The cafe serves simple meals affordably.
entries.zh: 这家咖啡馆以实惠价格供应简单餐食。

entries.meaningZh: 活跃于美国两岸的〔美式口语〕
entries.en: Her bicoastal career took her between New York and Los Angeles.
entries.zh: 她在美国两岸发展的职业生涯使她往返于纽约和洛杉矶。

entries.en: The essay explores visuality through maps and diagrams.
entries.zh: 文章通过地图和示意图探讨可视性。

entries.en: The engineer tested a deployable antenna on the model.
entries.zh: 工程师测试了模型上的可展开天线。

entries.en: A laburnum shaded the garden bench.
entries.zh: 一株金链花为花园长凳遮阴。

entries.en: The smokejumper checked his equipment before boarding the aircraft.
entries.zh: 空降森林灭火员登机前检查了装备。

entries.en: The manual compares two notational systems for large numbers.
entries.zh: 手册比较了大数的两种记数体系。

entries.en: The diagram labels the submandibular region beneath the jaw.
entries.zh: 示意图标出了下颌下方的区域。

entries.en: Her bleeper sounded while she was checking the records.
entries.zh: 她查看记录时，无线电传呼机响了。

entries.en: The report considered the reputational damage caused by the delay.
entries.zh: 报告考虑了延误造成的声誉损害。

entries.en: The sayer of that promise never returned to fulfill it.
entries.zh: 作出那个承诺的人再也没有回来履行承诺。

entries.en: A round, upholstered humpty stood beside the reading chair.
entries.zh: 阅读椅旁放着一张圆形软垫矮凳。

entries.en: The investigation uncovered unauthorized wiretapping of private calls.
entries.zh: 调查发现了未经授权窃听私人电话的行为。

entries.en: The shop sent a mailshot announcing its spring sale.
entries.zh: 商店寄出广告，宣布春季促销。

entries.en: Her affiliative gestures helped the newcomers feel welcome.
entries.zh: 她富有亲和力的举止让新来者感到受欢迎。

entries.en: He nodded noncommittally when asked about the proposal.
entries.zh: 被问及提案时，他不置可否地点了点头。

entries.en: The musician tuned the tabla before the concert.
entries.zh: 乐手在音乐会前为塔布拉手鼓调音。

entries.en: The old song was traditionally sung at Yule.
entries.zh: 这首老歌传统上在圣诞节期演唱。

entries.en: The printer worked infuriatingly slowly when we were already late.
entries.zh: 我们本已迟到，打印机还慢得令人恼火。

entries.en: The volcanologist collected samples near the cooled lava flow.
entries.zh: 火山学家在冷却的熔岩流附近采集样本。

entries.en: An Ulsterman in our group recognized the familiar accent.
entries.zh: 我们组的一位乌尔斯特人听出了那种熟悉的口音。

entries.en: The model shows how the biomolecule changes shape.
entries.zh: 模型展示了这个生物分子如何改变形状。

entries.en: The simulation adds Brownian motion to the particle paths.
entries.zh: 模拟在粒子轨迹中加入了布朗运动。

entries.en: The lecture examined coevolution between plants and their pollinators.
entries.zh: 讲座考察了植物与其传粉者之间的共同进化。

entries.en: A turreted gatehouse guarded the approach to the castle.
entries.zh: 一座带角塔的门楼守着通往城堡的道路。

entries.en: A birdwatcher waited patiently beside the reed bed.
entries.zh: 一位观鸟者在芦苇丛旁耐心等候。

entries.en: The recording showed a brief hyperkinetic episode.
entries.zh: 录像显示了一次短暂的运动过度发作。

entries.en: A falling boulder could smithereen the fragile wooden bridge.
entries.zh: 落下的巨石可能把脆弱的木桥砸成碎片。

entries.meaningZh: 同类中特别大的东西〔口语〕
entries.en: The angler proudly lifted a lunker from the net.
entries.zh: 钓鱼者自豪地从网中提起一条大鱼。

entries.en: The waterbed shifted gently when she sat down.
entries.zh: 她坐下时，水床轻轻晃动。

entries.en: The local jefe addressed his officers in the courtyard.
entries.zh: 当地军事首脑在院子里向军官们讲话。

entries.en: The children wanted the goodie to defeat the villain.
entries.zh: 孩子们希望正面人物打败反派。

entries.en: The recycling center separates nonferrous metals from steel.
entries.zh: 回收中心把有色金属与钢材分开。

entries.en: A proselytizer offered leaflets to passersby outside the station.
entries.zh: 一位劝人改宗者在车站外向路人发传单。

entries.en: The lone appointment was criticized as tokenism.
entries.zh: 这唯一的一次任命被批评为装门面。

entries.en: The therapist explored the patient's intrapsychic conflicts.
entries.zh: 治疗师探讨了患者的内心冲突。

entries.en: The players gathered for a short shootaround before lunch.
entries.zh: 球员们在午饭前聚在一起做了简短的投篮训练。

entries.en: The survey took them into the backwoods beyond the lake.
entries.zh: 勘测把他们带进了湖外偏僻的林地。

entries.en: The reporter interviewed an oddsmaker about the upcoming race.
entries.zh: 记者就即将举行的比赛采访了一位赔率制定者。

entries.en: The operator checked the downspout beneath the processing vessel.
entries.zh: 操作员检查了处理容器下方的降液管。

entries.en: The opening of the railway brought a local building boomlet.
entries.zh: 铁路开通使当地建筑业短暂繁荣。

entries.en: The candidate faced strong intraparty opposition to her proposal.
entries.zh: 这位候选人的提案遭到了强烈的党内反对。

entries.en: The corrector marked several misplaced commas in the proof.
entries.zh: 校对者在校样上标出了几个位置不当的逗号。

entries.en: Please redial the number if the line stays busy.
entries.zh: 如果线路一直占线，请重拨号码。

entries.en: The experiment used a monocular viewing device.
entries.zh: 实验使用了一种单眼观察装置。

entries.en: The laboratory measured methylmercury in the collected fish samples.
entries.zh: 实验室测量了采集鱼样中的甲基汞。

entries.en: The treatment caused disaggregation of the clustered particles.
entries.zh: 处理使聚集的颗粒发生了解聚。

entries.en: The gardener mixed perlite into the potting soil.
entries.zh: 园丁把珍珠岩混入盆栽土中。

entries.en: The committee quickly approved the uncontentious parts of the plan.
entries.zh: 委员会很快批准了计划中没有争议的部分。
